newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Wall Street wallops Australian stocks at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street wallops Australian stocks at open.

text.p: The Australian share market dived at the opening on Friday as an already nervous market trailed a sharply weaker Wall Street lower.
The All Ordinaries index was donw 18.9 points at 2,320.7 in early trading.
Brokers said the volatility of Wall Street continued to erode investor confidence with U.S. market action remaining the focus of attention for traders.
"There are no surprises here," said a Sydney broker.
"The U.S. markets are all over the place and we aren't immune from movements like that," he said, adding that there were few local factors to compensate for a wobbly Wall Street.
"It will settle down but it's hard to see any positives."
Losses were across the board in the leaders although most were quickly coming off early lows.
Falls outnumbered rises by a ratio of about five to one, while about 33 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
